verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at public.missiveapp.com/v1. The endpoint reference covers analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels with example requests, and published rate limits include 429/Retry-After headers. The docs are agent-readable as Markdown and via docs/llms.txt, and API access is listed on paid plans. An official MCP server is also documented and changelog-confirmed for API-created drafts. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes all 404), a formal versioning/deprecation policy (only inline breaking-change notes), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
